newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN FANS WALK OFF WITH OLYMPIC STADIUM TURF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN FANS WALK OFF WITH OLYMPIC STADIUM TURF.

text.p: Groundstaff at Munich's Olympic stadium were working hard on Monday to restore the pitch for Wednesday's European Cup final after celebrating Bayern Munich fans walked off with the turf at the weekend.
The fans ripped up slabs of turf after the club clinched a record 14th German title on the ground on Saturday.
But stadium official Arno Hartung said the pitch would be in perfect order for the final between Borussia Dortmund and Juventus.
"We had to do a bit more work than we would usually do after a normal Bundesliga match but all the preparations are going fine," he said.
